title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: accounting skills in Excel and Cowork
summary: The briefing passes: the updated Microsoft plugin pages still support its availability, licensing and blocking guidance, and the roadmap facts match the supplied record. The previously reported fetch failures did not recur. One minor correction remains: the rollout checklist asks users to enable an audit trail that has no corresponding controls-table row.

claims.claim: Excel accounting-skills rollout mechanics are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Excel accounting skills rollout default'; read roadmap and Excel skills overview. The roadmap reports limited Insiders use but no rollout procedure; the Excel overview's channel requirements apply to custom skills, not this accounting capability.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls

claims.fix: Remove 'and ask them to switch it on for entries and reconciliations' from the At rollout audit-trail bullet, leaving: 'Tell pilot users that the audit trail is a choice they make when invoking a capability.'
